description: This file defines a builder class 'MappingStrategiesBuilder' that facilitates the creation and management of a mapping strategies collection used in JSON deserialization within a larger project. It provides methods to add various JSON parsing strategies keyed by type identifiers and includes default strategies for known classes, mainly for internal map configuration.

classes.name: MappingStrategiesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class that manages a map of mapping strategies for JSON deserialization keyed by string types. It provides methods to add, configure, and build the final set of strategies.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder with default known strategies.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSONParsableRegistry or JSON deserialization functions associated with class types or string keys to the builder.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Inserts all strategies from another map into this builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates an immutable MappingStrategies object encapsulating all added strategies.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static method to create a new builder instance pre-populated with default strategies.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add JSON deserialization strategies by registry, class, or type string.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all strategies from a provided map.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns the constructed mapping strategies as an immutable object.
